blocks.en: 88.1 Burkitt Lymphoma
blocks.zh: 88.1 伯基特淋巴瘤

blocks.en: 88.1.1 Definition and Epidemiology BL accounts for around 2% of all adult NHL with a higher incidence in patients with immunodeficiency and in patients who have HIV infection. There is an endemic pediatric subtype in equatorial Africa, which is strongly associated with EBV. The clinical course of BL usually is highly aggressive with a Ki67 expression of nearly 100% requiring prompt institution of therapy.
blocks.zh: 88.1.1 定義和流行病學 BL 約佔所有成人 NHL 的 2%，在免疫缺陷患者和 HIV 感染患者中發病率較高。赤道非洲有一種流行的兒科亞型，與 EB 病毒密切相關。 BL 的臨床病程通常具有高度侵襲性，Ki67 表達接近 100%，需要立即開始治療。

blocks.en: 88.1.2 Diagnosis A tissue biopsy/cytology sample is mandatory for the diagnosis. The translocation of MYC with the immunoglobulin heavy-chain loci (IgH), 80% or less frequently, with kappa or lambda lightchains,isthemolecularhallmarkofBL.Diagnosis requires a combination of morphology, immunophenotype, and genetic analysis.
blocks.zh: 〔88.1.2 診斷〕診斷必須取得組織切片或細胞學檢體。MYC 與免疫球蛋白重鏈基因座（IgH）的易位約占 80%；較少見者為 MYC 與 kappa 或 lambda 輕鏈基因座易位。此為 BL 的分子標誌。診斷須綜合形態學、免疫表型及遺傳分析。

blocks.en: 88.1.3 Prognostic Factors Several studies have identified prognostic factors for poor outcome. The Burkitt lymphoma International Prognostic Index (BL-IPI) identified four variables (age ≥40 years, performance status ≥2, serum LDH >3 × upper limit of normal, and CNS involvement) with independent prognostic value for PFS and OS (Olszewski et al. 2021).
blocks.zh: 88.1.3 預後因素 幾項研究已經確定了不良結果的預後因素。伯基特淋巴瘤國際預後指數 (BL-IPI) 確定了四個對 PFS 和 OS 具有獨立預後價值的變數（年齡 ≥40 歲、體能狀態 ≥2、血清 LDH >3 × 正常值上限以及 CNS 受累）（Olszewski 等，2021）。

blocks.en: 88.1.4 First Line Treatment The optimal first-line therapy in BL has not been defined yet. To achieve a fast and stable remission, an intensive regimen combining several compounds is used in most centers. Combinations of rituximab, DOX, alkylators, vincristine, and VP with direct therapy to prevent CNS disease are highly active. Frequently used regimens are the HOVON R-CODOX-M/R-IVAC (RTX, CY, vincristine, DOX, MTX, IFO, Ara-C, VP) (Mead et al. 2002), R-HyperCVAD (RTX, hyperfractionated CY, vincristine, DOX, dexamethasone) (Thomas et al. 1999), and the GMALL-B-ALLprotocol (RTX, MTX, Ara-C, CY, VP, IFO)
blocks.zh: 88.1.4 第一線治療 BL 中的最佳第一線治療尚未確定。為了實現快速穩定的緩解，大多數中心採用結合多種化合物的強化治療方案。利妥昔單抗、DOX、烷化劑、長春新鹼和 VP 與直接療法的組合對於預防 CNS 疾病具有高度活性。常用的治療方案是 HOVON R-CODOX-M/R-IVAC（RTX、CY、長春新鹼、DOX、MTX、IFO、Ara-C、VP）（Mead 等人，2002 年）、R-HyperCVAD（RTX、超 CY、長春新鹼、DOX、1999（MALL-999）（Thomas-999999%）（ThomasBALL-9999）（M協定（RTX、MTX、Ara-C、CY、VP、IFO）

blocks.en: (Hoelzer et al. 2014). With these protocols, a significant portion of patients have a chance to get cured with first-line therapy. For patients not feasible for intensive treatment, dose-adjusted EPOCH-R (rituximab, VP, vincristine, CY, and DOX) may be an option (Roschewski et al. 2020).
blocks.zh: （Hoelzer 等人，2014 年）。透過這些方案，很大一部分患者有機會透過第一線治療得到治癒。對於不適合強化治療的患者，劑量調整的 EPOCH-R（利妥昔單抗、VP、長春新鹼、CY 和 DOX）可能是一種選擇 (Roschewski et al. 2020)。

blocks.en: 88.1.5 Autologous HCT There are several studies exploring the role of auto HCT in first remission. In a prospective trial, the HOVON group treated 27 patients with two cycles of intensive induction followed by BEAMconditioned auto HCT for those patients achieving at least a PR (van Imhoff et al. 2005). The 5-year EFS and OS was 73% and 81%, respectively. In a retrospective analysis of 117 patients receiving auto HCT as part of first-line therapy between 1984 and 1994, patients in CR at time of transplant had a 3-year OS of 72% (Sweetenham et al. 1996). In the relapse situation, patients who were chemotherapy sensitive had a 3-year OS of 37% following auto HCT compared to just 7% for those who were chemotherapy resistant (Sweetenham et al. 1996). In summary, auto HCT in BL is feasible, but there is no documented advantage compared to standard combination chemotherapy for patients responding sufficient to first line. Auto HCT may be used to optimize remission in patients with insufficient response or as bridging to allo HCT. In the relapse setting, given the intensive regimens usually used as first line, the difficulty lies in achieving a response good enough to proceed to auto HCT and to collect SC, hence auto HCT is rarely used in BL.
blocks.zh: 88.1.5 自體 HCT 有幾項研究探討了自體 HCT 在首次緩解中的作用。在一項前瞻性試驗中，HOVON 組對 27 名患者進行了兩個週期的強化誘導治療，然後對那些至少達到 PR 的患者進行 BEAM 條件自體 HCT（van Imhoff 等，2005）。 5 年 EFS 和 OS 分別為 73% 和 81%。在 1984 年至 1994 年間接受自體 HCT 作為第一線治療一部分的 117 名患者進行的回顧性分析中，移植時處於 CR 的患者的 3 年 OS 為 72%（Sweetenham 等，1996）。在復發情況下，對化療敏感的患者在自體 HCT 後的 3 年 OS 為 37%，而化療抗藥性患者的 3 年 OS 僅為 7%（Sweetenham 等，1996）。總之，BL 中的自體 HCT 是可行的，但對於對第一線反應足夠的患者，與標準聯合化療相比，沒有記錄的優勢。自體 HCT 可用於優化緩解不足的患者的緩解或作為同種異體 HCT 的橋樑。在復發情況下，考慮到通常用作第一線的強化治療方案，困難在於獲得足夠好的反應以進行自體 HCT 並收集 SC，因此自體 HCT 很少用於 BL。

blocks.en: 88.1.6 Allogeneic HCT Indicated in CR ≥2 Donor MRS > MUD > mMUD Conditioning RIC > MAC TRM (1 year) 30% OS (5 years) 30–40% DFS 35% Adapted from Peniket et al. (2003) The kinetics of BL with rapidly progressive disease may not allow for the 4–6 week waiting period during screening, apheresis, and manufacturing necessary for CAR T-cell therapy.
blocks.zh: 〔88.1.6 異體 HCT〕適應症：CR ≥2。供者優先序：MRS > MUD > mMUD。調理：RIC > MAC。1 年 TRM 30%；5 年 OS 30–40%；DFS 35%（改寫自 Peniket et al. 2003）。BL 進展迅速，可能無法等待 CAR-T 細胞治療在篩選、單採及製造所需的 4–6 週。

blocks.en: 88.2 Lymphoblastic Lymphoma
blocks.zh: 88.2 淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤

blocks.en: 88.2.1 Definition and Epidemiology LBL is an aggressive neoplasm of precursor B cells (B-LBL) or T cells (T-LBL) with features of acute leukemia. It accounts for approximately 2% of all NHL. In adults, around 90% of all LBL are T-LBL.
blocks.zh: 88.2.1 定義和流行病學 LBL 是前體 B 細胞 (B-LBL) 或 T 細胞 (T-LBL) 的侵襲性腫瘤，具有急性白血病的特徵。它約佔所有 NHL 的 2%。在成人中，大約 90% 的 LBL 是 T-LBL。

blocks.en: 88.2.2 Diagnosis The diagnosis is based on an LN biopsy. T-LBL is usually TdT positive with variable expression of other T-cell markers (CD7 and CD3 are often positive).
blocks.zh: 88.2.2 診斷 診斷基於 LN 活檢。 T-LBL 通常為 TdT 陽性，並伴隨其他 T 細胞標記物的可變表達（CD7 和 CD3 通常為陽性）。

blocks.en: 88.2.3 Prognostic Factors At this time, no convincing prognostic model for these patients is available. Several studies tried to identify risk factors, the following may be associated with an unfavorable outcome: elevated LDH, BM, or CNS involvement, and stage IV disease. There is also an association with lymphotropic viral infections, e.g., HTLV-1. The role of MRD in LBL has not been defined yet, but as we learned from acute leukemias and other lymphomas, persisted MRD positivity might be a predictor of poor outcome.
blocks.zh: 88.2.3 預後因素 目前，尚無針對這些患者的令人信服的預後模型。多項研究試圖確定危險因素，以下因素可能與不良結果相關：LDH 升高、BM 或 CNS 受累以及 IV 期疾病。它也與嗜淋巴細胞病毒感染有關，例如 HTLV-1。 MRD 在 LBL 中的作用尚未明確，但正如我們從急性白血病和其他淋巴瘤中了解到的那樣，持續的 MRD 陽性可能是預後不良的預測因子。

blocks.en: 88.2.4 First-Line Treatment Standard approaches for patients with LBL are adapted to ALL protocols. These regimens contain multiple drugs, such as corticosteroids, CY, MTX, vincristine, Ara-C, thioguanine, L-asp, VP, nitrosoureas, and anthracyclines. Intrathecal CNS prophylaxis is mandatory. With these protocols, a CR rate more than 80% and a significant chance of cure has been reported [overview in Intermesoli et al. (2022)].
blocks.zh: 88.2.4 第一線治療 LBL 患者的標準方法適用於 ALL 方案。這些方案包含多種藥物，如皮質類固醇、CY、MTX、長春新鹼、Ara-C、硫鳥嘌呤、L-asp、VP、亞硝基脲和蒽環類藥物。鞘內中樞神經系統預防是強制性的。據報導，透過這些方案，CR 率超過 80%，並且治癒的機會很大[Intermesoli 等人的概述]。 （2022）]。

blocks.en: 88.2.5 Autologous Transplantation Since most centers prefer allo HCT over auto HCT because of GVL effect, there are only very few studies evaluating the role of auto HCT in LBL. In CR1, the use of auto HCT as a consolidation may improve relapse-free survival, but has no effect on OS (Sweetenham et al. 2001). In another study in 128 patients with LBL receiving auto HCT, RR at 5 years was 56% (Levine et al. 2003). No documented role in more advanced disease >CR1 is reported either. In conclusion, data for auto HCT in LBL are too scarce to come to firm conclusions.
blocks.zh: 〔88.2.5 自體移植〕由於 GVL 效應，多數中心偏好異體 HCT，自體 HCT 在 LBL 的研究很少。CR1 時以自體 HCT 鞏固可能改善無復發存活，但不影響 OS（Sweetenham et al. 2001）。另一項納入 128 名 LBL 患者的研究顯示，自體 HCT 後 5 年 RR 為 56%（Levine et al. 2003）；>CR1 的較晚期疾病亦無確立角色。總之，現有資料不足以得出明確結論。

blocks.en: 88.2.6 Allogeneic Transplantation There is also no established role for allo HCT in patients with LBL. Compared to auto HCT, allo HCT is associated with a higher TRM but lower RR. In 76 patients receiving allo HCT, 5-year RR was 34% (Levine et al. 2003). In this retrospective study, there was no significant difference in OS at 1 year and 5 years between auto HCT and allo HCT. In the relapse setting, bridging with nelarabine might be an option (Candoni et al. 2020). In general, the indication for allo HCT should be based on risk factors, remission, and MRD.
blocks.zh: 88.2.6 同種異體移植 同種異體 HCT 在 LBL 患者中的作用尚未確定。與自體 HCT 相比，allo HCT 具有較高的 TRM 但較低的 RR。在 76 名接受異體 HCT 的患者中，5 年 RR 為 34%（Levine 等，2003）。在這項回顧性研究中，自體 HCT 和異基因 HCT 之間 1 年和 5 年的 OS 沒有顯著差異。在復發情況下，用奈拉濱橋接可能是一種選擇（Candoni et al. 2020）。一般來說，allo HCT 的適應症應基於風險因素、緩解情況和 MRD。

blocks.en: 88.3 Peripheral T Cell Lymphomas
blocks.zh: 88.3 週邊 T 細胞淋巴瘤

blocks.en: 88.3.1 Definition and Epidemiology PTCLs are a very heterogenous group of lymphomas originating from the T cell lineage. They account for approximately 10–15% of all NHL. Because of this low incidence, large randomized studies are difficult to perform.
blocks.zh: 88.3.1 定義和流行病學 PTCL 是起源於 T 細胞譜系的一組非常異質的淋巴瘤。它們約佔所有 NHL 的 10-15%。由於發生率低，因此很難進行大型隨機研究。

blocks.en: 88.3.2 Diagnosis The diagnosis, as in any NHL, should be based on a LN biopsy. The differential diagnosis between PTCL and other types of T-NHL is crucial for the outcomes, and in some specific cases, the treatments are very different.
blocks.zh: 88.3.2 診斷 與任何 NHL 一樣，診斷應基於 LN 活檢。 PTCL 和其他類型的 T-NHL 之間的鑑別診斷對於結果至關重要，並且在某些特定病例中，治療方法有很大不同。

blocks.en: 88.3.3 Risk Factors The IPI is the most commonly used prognostic tool in PTCL. The following factors are associated with worse outcome: age >60 years, ECOG >1, elevated LDH, stages III–IV, and extranodal involvement >1 site. Another prognostic tool is the PIT score, which is calculated by four parameters as age, ECOG, LDH level, and BM involvement. In anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALCL), the tumors are categorized in ALK+ or ALK− with better prognosis for ALK+ lymphomas.
blocks.zh: 88.3.3 危險因子 IPI 是 PTCL 中最常用的預後工具。以下因素與較差的結果相關：年齡 >60 歲、ECOG >1、LDH 升高、III-IV 期、結外受累 >1 個部位。另一個預後工具是 PIT 評分，它由年齡、ECOG、LDH 水平和 BM 參與等四個參數計算得出。在間變性大細胞淋巴瘤 (ALCL) 中，腫瘤分為 ALK+ 或 ALK−，ALK+ 淋巴瘤的預後較好。

blocks.en: 88.3.4 First-Line Treatment The primary goal of first-line treatment is to get a deep and continuing remission. Standard regimens are anthracycline-containing combinations like CHOP or CHOEP, achieving a 3-year EFS of 50–70% and a 3-year OS of 75–80% (Schmitz et al. 2010). In CD30-positive PTCL, the addition of brentuximab to chemotherapy improves PFS and OS (Horwitz et al. 2022). In the relapse situation, the overall prognosis of PTLC is dismal, and the optimal treatment for these patients has not been defined yet. Relapse patients not able to receive intensive treatment including HCT may be offered single-agent therapy, e.g., gemcitabine, or in case of CD30 expression brentuximab vedotin.
blocks.zh: 88.3.4 第一線治療 第一線治療的主要目標是獲得深度且持續的緩解。標準治療方案是含有蒽環類藥物的組合，例如 CHOP 或 CHOEP，可實現 50-70% 的 3 年 EFS 和 75-80% 的 3 年 OS（Schmitz 等，2010）。在 CD30 陽性 PTCL 中，化療中添加 brentuximab 可改善 PFS 和 OS (Horwitz et al. 2022)。在復發的情況下，PTLC的整體預後很差，且這些患者的最佳治療方案尚未確定。無法接受包括 HCT 在內的強化治療的復發患者可以接受單藥治療，例如吉西他濱，或在 CD30 表達的情況下使用 brentuximab vedotin。

blocks.en: 88.3.5 Autologous Transplantation Indicated in CR1 (IPI >1); CR ≥2 Conditioning BEAC, BEAM, LEAM, CBV TRM (1 year) 5–7% REL (3 years) 40–50% OS (5 years) 70% (CR1) 50% (CR ≥2) PFS (5 years) 50% (CR1) 20–35% (CR ≥2) Adapted from Kyriakou et al. (2008), d'Amore et al. (2012), Wilhelm et al. (2016) and Kewalramani et al. (2006)
blocks.zh: 〔88.3.5 自體移植〕適應症：CR1（IPI >1）或 CR ≥2。調理：BEAC、BEAM、LEAM 或 CBV。1 年 TRM 5–7%；3 年 REL 40–50%；5 年 OS：CR1 為 70%、CR ≥2 為 50%；5 年 PFS：CR1 為 50%、CR ≥2 為 20–35%（改寫自 Kyriakou et al. 2008；d'Amore et al. 2012；Wilhelm et al. 2016；Kewalramani et al. 2006）。

(2006), Schmitz et al. (2014, 2018) and Dodero et al. (2012)
blocks.zh: 〔88.3.6 異體移植〕適應症：CR ≥2，或自體 HCT 後復發。供者優先序：MRS > MUD > mMUD。調理：RIC > MAC。GVHD 預防：CsA、CsA-MTX 或 CsA-MMF。植入失敗 <10%；1 年 TRM 20–25%；3 年 REL 20–40%；3 年 OS 40–60%；3 年 PFS 30–50%（改寫自 Kewalramani et al. 2006；Schmitz et al. 2014, 2018；Dodero et al. 2012）。

blocks.en: 88.4 Cutaneous T Cell Lymphomas
blocks.zh: 88.4 皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤

blocks.en: 88.4.1 Definition and Epidemiology Cutaneous T cell lymphomas (CTCLs) are a spectrum of lymphoid malignancies characterized by clonal expansion of T-cells primarily involving the skin, which may extend to other organs in advanced forms. CTCLs are relatively rare, with an incidence of approximately six patients per million people (Dobos et al. 2020). The commonest forms (70%) are mycosis fungoides (MF) and Sezary syndrome (SS).Although the exact risk factors for CTCLs remain unclear, an interplay between intrinsic and environmental factors exists.
blocks.zh: 88.4.1 定義與流行病學 皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤 (CTCL) 是一系列淋巴惡性腫瘤，其特徵是 T 細胞克隆性擴增，主要涉及皮膚，晚期可能會擴展到其他器官。 CTCL 相對罕見，每百萬人的發生率約為 6 名患者（Dobos 等人，2020）。最常見的形式 (70%) 是蕈樣肉芽腫 (MF) 和塞扎里症候群 (SS)。儘管 CTCL 的確切危險因子尚不清楚，但內在因素和環境因素之間存在相互作用。

blocks.en: 88.4.2 Diagnosis and Staging Diagnosis of MF/SS can be challenging and requires clinical data, histopathological findings, and molecular testing. Staging is based on a TNMB classification revised by the ISCL and EORTC (Olsen et al. 2007). Patients with earlystage disease, including skin patches and plaques (stages I–IIA), have an indolent clinical course with excellent long-term survival. Patients with advanced-stage disease, including erythroderma, tumors, or significant blood, nodal or visceral involvement (stages IIB–IV), have poor prognosis with a median survival that does not goes beyond 2–5 years.
blocks.zh: 88.4.2 診斷和分期 MF/SS 的診斷可能具有挑戰性，需要臨床數據、組織病理學結果和分子檢測。分期是基於 ISCL 和 EORTC 修訂的 TNMB 分類（Olsen 等人，2007 年）。患有早期疾病（包括皮膚斑塊和斑塊（I-IIA 期））的患者俱有惰性臨床病程，具有良好的長期存活率。晚期疾病患者，包括紅皮症、腫瘤或嚴重血液、淋巴結或內臟受累（IIB-IV 期），預後不良，中位存活期不超過 2-5 年。

blocks.en: 88.4.3 Therapeutic Management The initial management of CTCLs is directed to control symptoms and improve quality of life, particularly in patients with early-stage disease. Some of these patients can have an expectant period, but the vast majority will start with skindirected therapies, such as topical steroids, total skin electron beam therapy, ultraviolet B phototherapy, PUVA, and others (Quaglino et al. 2021). Patients with refractory early-stage or advancedstage disease have multiple therapeutic options, albeit most with low response rates and duration (Giordano and Pagano 2022). Some novel targeted therapies such as brentuximab vedotin and mogamulizumab have emerged with promising results. However, allogeneic HCT remains the only potential curative option.
blocks.zh: 88.4.3 治療管理 CTCL 的初始管理旨在控制症狀和改善生活質量，特別是對於早期疾病患者。其中一些患者可能會有一段等待期，但絕大多數會從皮膚定向治療開始，例如局部類固醇、全皮膚電子束治療、紫外線 B 光療、PUVA 等 (Quaglino et al. 2021)。患有難治性早期或晚期疾病的患者有多種治療選擇，儘管大多數治療方案的緩解率和持續時間較低（Giordano 和 Pagano 2022）。一些新型標靶療法，如 brentuximab vedotin 和 mogamulizumab 已經出現，並取得了有希望的結果。然而，同種異體 HCT 仍然是唯一潛在的治療選擇。

blocks.en: 88.4.4 Allogeneic HCT EBMT has led international efforts to examine the role of allogeneic HCT in patients with CTCLs (Duarte et al. 2008, 2010, 2014; Domingo-Domenech et al. 2021). Overall, high relapse rate remains the major cause of failure and needs to be improved with better strategies before and after transplant. Nevertheless, with a long follow-up in survivors of more than 6 years, we have shown that allogeneic HCT can rescue over one third of patients with advanced-stage and refractory CTCLs, and it remains a clinical option for patients with advanced-stage CTCLs (Snowden et al. 2022). Also, over time there is a trend to offer allogeneic HCT earlier in the course of the disease, including older patients as well as the use of more unrelated donors.
blocks.zh: 88.4.4 同種異體 HCT EBMT 引領國際社會努力研究同種異體 HCT 在 CTCL 患者中的作用（Duarte 等人，2008、2010、2014；Domingo-Domenech 等人，2021）。整體而言，高復發率仍然是失敗的主要原因，需要在移植前後採取更好的策略來改善。儘管如此，透過對倖存者超過 6 年的長期隨訪，我們發現同種異體 HCT 可以挽救超過三分之一的晚期和難治性 CTCL 患者，並且它仍然是晚期 CTCL 患者的臨床選擇（Snowden 等，2022）。此外，隨著時間的推移，有一種趨勢是在病程早期提供同種異體 HCT，包括老年患者以及使用更多不相關的捐贈者。

blocks.en: 88.5 HIV-Associated Lymphomas
blocks.zh: 88.5 HIV 相關淋巴瘤

blocks.en: 88.5.1 Definition and Epidemiology Patients infected with HIV have an increased risk of developing NHLs as compared to the general population. The most frequent subtypes are DLBCL and BL which both are AIDS-defining
blocks.zh: 88.5.1 定義和流行病學 與一般人群相比，感染 HIV 的患者發生 NHL 的風險增加。最常見的亞型是 DLBCL 和 BL，它們都是愛滋病的定義

blocks.en: illnesses, and HL, which is one of the non-AIDSdefining malignancies.
blocks.zh: 疾病和 HL，這是非愛滋病定義的惡性腫瘤之一。

blocks.en: 88.5.2 Risk Factors Factors that determine prognosis in patients with HIV-related lymphoma are the same as in the general population. Additionally, a low CD4+ T-cell count and an uncontrolled HIV viral load are independent risk factors for HIV-lymphomas.
blocks.zh: 88.5.2 危險因子 決定 HIV 相關淋巴瘤患者預後的因素與一般人相同。此外，CD4+ T 細胞數低和 HIV 病毒量不受控制是 HIV 淋巴瘤的獨立危險因子。

blocks.en: 88.5.3 First-Line Therapy The availability of combination antiretroviral therapy (cART), along with the better management of opportunistic infections, allows HIVinfected patients with lymphoma to receive the same treatment approaches as HIV-uninfected patients. The consequent use of cART during therapy is of major important for successful treatment. The indication for HCT has to be discussed in the relapse situation.
blocks.zh: 88.5.3 第一線治療 聯合抗逆轉錄病毒治療 (cART) 的可用性以及對機會性感染的更好管理，使 HIV 感染的淋巴瘤患者能夠接受與未感染 HIV 的患者相同的治療方法。在治療過程中隨後使用 cART 對於成功治療至關重要。 HCT 的適應症必須在復發情況下討論。

blocks.en: 88.5.4 Autologous Transplantation Indicated in CR ≥2; same indications as in general population with the same type of lymphoma Conditioning BEAC, BEAM, LEAM, CBV TRM (1 year) 5–7% REL (3 years) 30–40% OS (5 years) 50–60% PFS (5 years) 50–60% Adapted from Hübel et al. (2019), Diez-Martin et al. (2009) and Balsalobre et al. (2009)
blocks.zh: 〔88.5.4 自體移植〕適應症：CR ≥2；與一般族群中相同淋巴瘤類型的適應症一致。調理：BEAC、BEAM、LEAM 或 CBV。1 年 TRM 5–7%；3 年 REL 30–40%；5 年 OS 50–60%；5 年 PFS 50–60%（改寫自 Hübel et al. 2019；Diez-Martin et al. 2009；Balsalobre et al. 2009）。

blocks.en: 88.5.5 Allogeneic Transplantation Experience on the use of allo HCT in patients with lymphoma and HIV infection is limited and no definitive recommendation can be given at this time. There are some case reports or small retrospective analysis showing that allo HCT in HIV positive patients using MRD, MUD, or cord blood is feasible, but application of cART and viroimmunological reconstitution is a matter of debate. In a report of five HIV-positive patients who underwent allo HCT with various hematologic malignancies, there was no TRM or major infections (Mulanovich et al. 2016). HIV virus load remained undetectable with continuous cART. Three patients relapsed 6, 7, and 13 months after transplant, and two were alive and well after 42 and 55 months. There are a few case reports available showing that the application of CAR-T-cell therapy is feasible in HIV-related lymphomas.
blocks.zh: 88.5.5 同種異體移植 在淋巴瘤和 HIV 感染患者中使用同種異體 HCT 的經驗有限，目前無法給出明確的建議。有一些病例報告或小型回顧性分析表明，使用 MRD、MUD 或臍帶血對 HIV 陽性患者進行同種異體 HCT 是可行的，但 cART 和病毒免疫重建的應用仍存在爭議。在一份關於 5 名患有各種血液惡性腫瘤的 HIV 陽性患者接受異基因 HCT 的報告中，沒有發生 TRM 或重大感染（Mulanovich 等，2016）。連續 cART 仍無法偵測到 HIV 病毒量。三名患者在移植後 6、7 和 13 個月復發，兩名患者在 42 和 55 個月後仍存活且狀況良好。有一些病例報告表明，CAR-T 細胞療法在 HIV 相關淋巴瘤中的應用是可行的。
